scan.method: whole-file Thumb BL (and B.W tail-calls) per provided encoding; literal-pool search for (wrapper|1)
scan.note: Band 0x2C490000–0x2C4C0000 has zero direct BL/B.W to these wrappers. HUD layout calls live elsewhere (set_size 762, align 578). lv_label_set_text was not recovered (lv_label.c string present at 0x2C41E17C but no pointer/ADR/MOVW xrefs). No lv_img.c / lv_img_set_zoom; zoom is style prop 0x6c.

lv_obj_set_size.notes: Confirmed Capstone: get/set style WIDTH (prop 1) then HEIGHT (prop 4) via FUN_2c606c7c / FUN_2c606ca0. User listed lv_obj_set_size ≈ 0x2C606F34; that address is actually set_pos (props 7/8). Real set_size is the next twin at 0x2C607048.

lv_obj_set_pos.notes: Confirmed Capstone of 0x2C606F00–0x2C607200: get/set style X (prop 7) then Y (prop 8) via FUN_2c606cc4 / FUN_2c606cd0. This is lv_obj_set_pos, not set_size.

lv_obj_set_style_text_font.notes: Thin 8-byte wrapper: mov r2,r1; movs r1,#0x42; b.w FUN_2c62b030. Prop 0x42 = TEXT_FONT.

lv_obj_set_style_radius.notes: Thin wrapper: mov r2,r1; movs r1,#0xb; b.w FUN_2c62b030. Prop 0xB = RADIUS.

literal_pools.note: 32-bit Thumb pointer (wrapper|1) in image; no nearby BLX/BX recovered

lv_style_set_width.notes: Required key. Disassembly is lv_obj_set_style_width (2-arg local style, prop 1), not lv_style_set_width(style,*). Tail-calls FUN_2c62b030.

lv_style_set_height.notes: Required key. Disassembly is lv_obj_set_style_height (2-arg local style, prop 4), not lv_style_set_height(style,*). Tail-calls FUN_2c62b030.

lv_obj_set_x.notes: Immediately after set_pos. Sets style X (prop 7) only.

lv_obj_set_y.notes: Immediately after set_x. Sets style Y (prop 8) only.

lv_obj_set_width.notes: Immediately after set_size. Sets style WIDTH (prop 1) only.

lv_obj_set_height.notes: Immediately after set_width. Sets style HEIGHT (prop 4) only.

lv_obj_align.notes: lv_obj_align(obj, align, x_ofs, y_ofs): FUN_2c606cdc (ALIGN prop 9) then X/Y like set_pos.

lv_obj_set_align.notes: movs r2,#0; b.w FUN_2c606cdc (ALIGN prop 9, selector 0).

transform_zoom.notes: lv_obj_set_style_transform_zoom(obj, value, selector): 12-byte wrapper passing prop 0x6c into FUN_2c603c40. FUN_2c606e98 treats 0x6c default 0x100 (LVGL zoom 256=1x) and 0x6d as angle. Ghidra missed this function (gap between prop-9 align @ 0x2C606CDC and prop-0x6d @ 0x2C606CF4). 2-arg convenience at 0x2C5D2A54 (movs r2,#0; sxth r1; b.w 0x2C606CE8) has 0 BL xrefs. No lv_img.c / lv_img_set_zoom in this binary.

lv_obj_set_style_transform_zoom.notes: Same function as transform_zoom. 3-arg (obj, zoom, selector).

lv_obj_set_style_transform_angle.notes: 3-arg wrapper prop 0x6d via FUN_2c603c40. Pair of transform_zoom.

lv_obj_set_style_prop_0x32.notes: Thin wrapper prop 0x32. Previously patched as outline_width; HUD outlines did not change.

lv_obj_set_local_style_prop.notes: Generic setter FUN_2c62b030. Thin 2-arg style wrappers tail-call (b.w) here.
